title: Law360 highlights Burford’s investment in Kindleworth as it expands into the US
summary: Law360 reports on Kindleworth’s expansion into the US market with the opening of its first New York office, highlighting Burford Capital’s role as a strategic minority investor in the business. Burford’s 2025 investment supports Kindleworth’s growth as it helps entrepreneurial lawyers establish and grow successful independent law firms. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*Law360* reports on Kindleworth’s expansion into the US market with the opening of its first New York office, highlighting Burford Capital’s role as a strategic minority investor in the business. Burford’s 2025 investment supports Kindleworth’s growth as it helps entrepreneurial lawyers establish and grow successful independent law firms.


Read the full article[here](https://www.law360.com/articles/2547811/burford-backed-kindleworth-opens-new-york-office) .
